# Agent kit

> Rules, a knowledge base, skills and GitHub checks that give any product the same AI coding agent setup, kept current with Copier.

To add the kit to a repository, follow the step-by-step guide for agents. It needs no prompts and works in cloud sessions.

- [Add the agent kit to a repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tukutupap/agent-kit/main/INSTALL.md): Copier answers, keeping existing files, the pull request, and what the person does afterwards.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tukutupap/agent-kit/main/README.md): What's in the kit and how updates arrive.
